record.question: The age of a tree can be determined by
options: Counting the annual growth rings of its stem
record.explanation: Answer D: Counting the annual growth rings of its stem. Annual growth rings in the trunk are counted to estimate a tree’s age, subject to species and growing conditions. Reference: https://www.nist.gov/how-do-you-measure-it/how-do-you-measure-age-tree. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
